stopReasons.title: Row 4 is ambiguous: two incompatible readings, and the documented text is a dangling reference
detail: The brief describes row 4 as 'the NodeRO (read-only runtime) mount' and verifies it by findmnt ro, runtime-bundle digest d7367e1b...6884 and xattr-measure read_only=true. Those three checks describe the runtime BUNDLE mount at /var/lib/tbound/runtime. That mount already exists, is ro, and already passes all three (pre-state above; abi8-readonly-remeasure-20261017.json). Reading A: row 4 is already satisfied and there is nothing to execute.

Elsewhere the project means the HOST NODE executable on an immutable read-only mount: docs/governed-setup.md:116-119 ('root-owned, protected, and on an immutable read-only mount (see section 4b)'), OVERVIEW.md:9 ('NodeRO mount'), abi8-runtime-provisioning-20261015.json prerequisite 9, abi8-measured-registration-20261015.json:95 and :172 ('immutableReadOnlyMount: false'). The brief's verifications do not test that.
The cross-reference is dangling: docs/governed-setup.md:326 section 4b is the child descriptor contract and contains no mount procedure.

No mechanism is documented: not whether it is a file bind of /usr/local/bin/node onto itself or a directory mount, not whether it is persistent (a .mount unit) or transient, and not the unit name. The signed profile pins the exact path /usr/local/bin/node (supervisor/internal/piruntime/host.go:58), so the choice is constrained but not specified.

No code checks it: abi8-bootstrap-calibration-20261015.json:37 and :274 record that no validator requires a Node immutability check, and git grep of non-test supervisor code finds none. A guessed mount therefore cannot be validated by the repo.
stopReasons.needsFromOwner: State whether row 4 means (A) the existing runtime-bundle ro bind (already done), or (B) the host Node ro mount, and if B, the mechanism and persistence (suggested but NOT adopted: a systemd var-usr-local-bin-node.mount unit with What=Where=/usr/local/bin/node, Options=bind,ro,nosuid,nodev, modelled on var-lib-tbound-runtime.mount) plus the matching verification.

stopReasons.title: Code conflict: the two service-unit validators cannot both accept any unit
detail: supervisor/internal/piruntime/managed_live_root_linux.go:1409 and :1417 (validateManagedSystemdPolicy) and :1814 (validateD09ManagedPiServiceUnit), changed by 0664c25, REQUIRE DelegateSubgroup=runner.

supervisor/cmd/tbound/pi_service_handoff_linux.go:424-428 (validatePiServiceUnit, called at :335 on the service startup path with the signed unit) permits only a closed Service directive set that does NOT contain DelegateSubgroup, and returns 'signed Pi service unit contains an unsupported section or directive' for any other directive.

A unit with DelegateSubgroup=runner passes the piruntime validators and fails the cmd/tbound validator. A unit without it does the reverse. No installed unit can satisfy the committed R8 layout and the runner's own handoff check. The R8 receipt (abi8-runtime-prerequisites-20261015-r8.json) lists no change to pi_service_handoff_linux.go; commit 0664c25 touched only piruntime, cmd/tbound/production_recovery_binder_linux.go and cmd/tbound-profile.
The installed unit (sha256 daf053a8...) predates R8 and lacks DelegateSubgroup, so it must change if R8 is to be honoured.
stopReasons.needsFromOwner: A repo fix adding DelegateSubgroup to the allowed Service directives and its exact-value check in pi_service_handoff_linux.go (separate session owns that file area), then the unit template as a committed file.

stopReasons.title: The required cgroup verification cannot exist after a unit install; the cells creation policy is undecided
detail: The service cgroup exists only while the unit runs: abi8-measured-registration-20261015.json:122 and abi8-bootstrap-calibration-20261015.json:103 and :112 ('cgroup is ephemeral ... the pre-provisioned directory did not survive'). The unit exits 2 INVALIDARGUMENT in about 10 ms without an admitted registration and host profile (:115), and signing is not approved, so the service cannot stay up.

Checks 'parent empty, runner leaf, cells path present, cgroup.kill, cgroup.events' therefore cannot be made true or observed without either a signed registration (not approved) or a measurement-only placeholder ExecStart, which abi8-measured-registration-20261015.json:208 states needs explicit separate approval.

No code or procedure creates <service>/cells: abi8-runtime-prerequisites-20261015-r8.json:208 ('Creation policy ... is a parent decision and is not implemented'); production_binder_linux.go opens it with os.Open and fails closed if absent. Because the parent is ephemeral, a one-time provisioning mkdir cannot persist either.
Kernel acceptance of DelegateSubgroup=runner under systemd 255 is listed as untested at abi8-runtime-prerequisites-20261015-r8.json 'untested'.
docs/governed-setup.md still carries the stale tbound-writer examples (lines 219-230) and does not mention DelegateSubgroup, the runner leaf or cells at all.
